kind.title: Thread kind
kind.description: Only company posts ('Who is hiring?'). Job-seeker threads are intentionally not supported: they contain personal data.

thread.title: Thread
thread.description: "latest" (resolve via whoishiring user) or a numeric HN item id for a specific monthly thread.

maxComments.title: Max comments
maxComments.description: 0 = all top-level comments on the thread.

query.title: Filter query
query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on comment text. Empty = no filter.
